items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: And that’s when the Captain saw this house and he said, “that’s it.” He bought it for a steal.

ctx.x: Yeah. So all the undesirables had congregated there. They were going to make that the dope center of the world, and they had this big fellow by the name of Skiboo, who was like an alloy, he could pick up this table with one hand and throw it through that window. And when they found out that this was about to happen, Findlay put all of them off the island. And they had to sell whatever they had, or allow some Bahamian to have 51% control. So this guy had just built this beautiful house down there, with gold door…
